description: This script manages and detects iOS development team IDs by inspecting system preferences, provisioning profiles, and Xcode configurations. It sets environment variables, loads team data from various sources, and outputs the selected team ID based on priorities.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Determines the presence of a suitable Python interpreter (python3, python, or /usr/bin/python3).

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Adds a team ID, its free status, and name to the internal lists if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads provisioning team IDs from Xcode preferences plist file.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads provisioning team IDs from legacy UserDefaults key.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Loads provisioning team IDs from Xcode managed provisioning profiles.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks if there is an Apple developer account configured in Xcode.
